name: Guitar lessons
summary: How expats start guitar lessons in Singapore — acoustic vs electric paths, kids vs adult beginner tracks, and condo noise-hour realities.
body:
Guitar teachers and music schools cover acoustic, electric, and classical pathways. Adult beginners often want chord songs fast; kids’ programmes lean on graded exams. Condo quiet hours shape practice and amp use.

## Formats
- 1:1 home or studio lessons
- Small group beginner classes
- Exam tracks (e.g. graded syllabi)
- Online lessons for travelling parents
- Instrument rental vs buy guidance

Clarify goals: campfire chords vs lead guitar vs exams.

## How to choose
Prefer teachers who set a 4-week skill plan and assign short daily practice. Ask about instrument sizing for kids. Confirm cancellation rules around school holidays.

## Practical tip
Start with a quiet practice amp or headphone setup. Neighbour complaints kill motivation faster than sore fingertips.
